notes: Master donor-to-feature transplant ledger for the founder's 2026-11-17 master directive (50 sources in groups A to H) plus donors already tracked by Orcel.

No donor code is imported, copied or sublicensed by this file. No repository was cloned for it; SHAs come from git ls-remote HEAD and everything else from the GitHub API at that SHA, read on 2026-11-17.

Wave 1 (Exa, TinyFish) and Wave 2 (HCU, Agent S, Stagehand) local clones and test results come from the REA workspaces D:\Orcel-REA and D:\Orcel-REA-W2 (read-only inputs; not in this repository). Every REA clone SHA matches the HEAD read here.

Licences were read from LICENSE, NOTICE, THIRD_PARTY and manifest files at each SHA; per-file headers were not read. Model weights, datasets and binaries are recorded separately and were not downloaded.

Founder decision 2026-11-17: licence type no longer blocks copying, renaming or publishing any source sent by the founder or present in the repository. Each record keeps the public licence as informational facts (for notices and provenance) beside authorization OWNER-ASSERTED (founder, 2026-11-17). The authorization is owner-asserted and is not independent legal verification.

Real blockers remain: private repositories are not accessible, hosted backends are not in any repository, and model weights are not in the repositories (their model-card terms must be read before download). Upstream notices and provenance must be kept with every copy.
One owner per feature: modules[].orcel_owner names the single Orcel unit that owns that feature; '(new)' units do not exist on main yet.

The companion records in capability_inventory.json map status as: NOT_ACQUIRED, SOURCE_ACQUIRED, REA_VERIFIED -> NOT STARTED; TRANSPLANTED -> IMPORTED; INTEGRATED -> INTEGRATED; TESTED -> TESTED; RELEASE_QUALIFIED -> RELEASED.

Records in group I are founder-named, group J were found by a discovery sweep of both organisations' public repositories. Authorization for them: OWNER-ASSERTED AUTHORIZATION — 2026-11-17 (owner-asserted, not independently verified). See vercel_expansion.
